message.content:
The title of “best player in soccer today” is highly debated and depends on the criteria you value—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or overall skill. As of mid‑2026, the most frequently cited names are:

| Player | Nationality | Club (2026) | Key Strengths |
|--------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Argentina | Inter Miami (MLS) | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, longevity |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | France | Paris Saint‑Germain | Pace, finishing, versatility |
| **Erling Haaland** | Norway | Manchester City | Physicality, goal‑scoring instinct, work rate |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Belgium | Manchester City | Passing range, tactical awareness, set‑piece mastery |
| **Neymar Jr.** | Brazil | Al‑Hilal (Saudi Pro League) | Flair, creativity, dribbling |
| **Robert Lewandowski** | Poland | FC Barcelona | Finishing, positioning, consistency |

If you’re looking at pure statistical output (goals + assists) over the last season, **Erling Haaland** and **Kylian Mbappé** often top the charts. In terms of overall influence on team performance and versatility, **Kevin De Bruyne** and **Lionel Messi** are frequently highlighted.

Ultimately, the “best” player is a matter of personal preference and the specific aspects of the game you value most.
